meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 有了这个技能,Claude 能自行修改运行环境:直接改记忆或指令文件;装系统包、npm 包或 MCP 服务器时,会请求批准并自动重启/重建;改代码时委托给 builder agent,新增专业能力则创建专用 agent,并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加新功能、安装工具或修改其工作方式时触发;如果请求含糊或不确定能否成功,它会先询问或先在工作区试验,不会直接改动。

say.text: 帮我装 ffmpeg 转录音频
say.note: 会请求管理员批准,通过后自动重建并重启环境。

say.text: 给我加一个能读 RSS 的 MCP 服务器
say.note: 会先找现成的 MCP 服务,有就接入并重启。

say.text: 以后每次回答前先列要点
say.note: 这属于改指令,直接改 memory 文件,无需批准。

howto.what_en: Claude can modify its runtime: edit memory/instructions directly; request approval for packages/MCP servers (auto-restart/rebuild); delegate code changes to a builder or create dedicated agents for new capabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a feature, install a tool, or change how Claude works. Ambiguous or uncertain requests are handled by asking or prototyping first.

say_en.note: Requests admin approval, then auto-rebuilds and restarts.

say_en.text: Add an MCP server for reading RSS feeds.
say_en.note: Checks for an existing one, then wires it up and restarts.

say_en.text: Always outline your answer before replying.
say_en.note: Edits memory/instructions directly, no approval needed.
